nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO converts VIN_5V to VCC_3V3 for MCU. VIN pin connects to external 5V rail, VOUT provides regulated 3.3V, GND is common return. Input and output need bypass capacitors. This module is the sole VCC_3V3 provider.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: STM32F103 ARM Cortex-M3 MCU operating at 3.3V. SPI1 (PA5=SCK, PA6=MISO, PA7=MOSI) drives MAX7219 LED driver. GPIO used for SPI chip select to MAX7219. BOOT0 pulled low for Flash boot mode. NRST needs pull-up. HSE crystal for system clock. SPI operates at 3.3V logic level; note level translation consideration to 5V MAX7219 input (may require external level shifter or 3.3V-tolerant 5V logic).

nodes.name: led_driver_max7219
nodes.description: MAX7219 8-digit LED display driver powered from 5V rail. Receives SPI commands from MCU: DIN (data in), CLK (clock), LOAD (chip select/latch). DOUT cascades serial data to 74HC595 shift register for output expansion. DIG_0-7 drive common cathode digit lines, SEG_A-G and SEG_DP drive anode segment lines. ISET requires external resistor to set segment current. Multiple GND pins for thermal and electrical grounding. VIN is 5V supply.
8-digit LED display driver

nodes.name: shift_register_74hc595
nodes.description: 74HC595 8-bit shift register powered from 5V rail. Receives cascaded serial data from MAX7219 DOUT output. Provides 8 additional parallel output bits for LED matrix expansion. Standard 74HC595 pins: SER (serial data input from MAX7219), SRCLK (shift register clock), RCLK (storage register clock/latch), OE (output enable, active low), SRCLR (shift register clear, active low), and Q0-Q7 parallel outputs. Note: brief implies cascaded connection from MAX7219; 74HC595 requires independent clock and latch control from MCU or derived from MAX7219 timing. Component list provides no pin details; downstream wiring must reference standard 74HC595 pinout.
8-bit shift register
